cp-000240.reason: Both programmes ask how taxes influence economic choices. Tilburg requires microeconomics, macroeconomics, public finance and fiscal economics. UCR develops that inquiry through public economics, behavioural economics, econometrics and policy evaluation. Its general law and accounting courses do not reproduce the specialist tax sequence. The complete Tilburg curriculum supports an ordinary comparison.

cp-000212.reason: All four degrees apply biology to oral disease from the first year and progress to oral diagnosis and treatment. The Groningen plan develops physiology, immunity, pathology, psychology and population health but never returns to the mouth or dentition as a sustained taught subject. Its advanced courses cannot support the claimed closest match.
